[Russian Far east]

There was a vibrant atmposphere at the newly opened spaceport of [Vostochny Cosmodrome](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vostochny_Cosmodrome) in the far-east of Russia. The new spaceport was a beautiful step for Russia by itself, not being dependent on the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan for launches (and the annual 100million usd pricetag) was very good for Russian space exploration and especially the budget.

Roscosmos State Corporation is enormously pleased to announce they have finally found investors for and are reviving [project Kliper](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kliper). After numerous tries to get western investors for this [manned reusable spacecraft](https://falsesteps.files.wordpress.com/2013/03/kliper-infographics.jpg) project over the last decade and getting snubbed every way. The [Chinese have agreed to invest](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/988700) 1,5 Billion usd in the project making the total budget around 3 billion usd. The Kliper is expected to provide efficent and reliable travel to any spacestations We expect the process to go pretty quickly as the Kliper has been in development for over a decade already and even had some testflights. A total of 6 Klipers are expected to be finished by 2020. Russia will keep the Klipers under own command (they can only be launched by Sojuz rockets anyway) but will offer the Chinese seats on the spacecraft whenever needed.

Development of the [Federation (spacecraft)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Federation_(spacecraft)) project is ongoing as well under Russia's autonomous development. The [PTK NP project](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yshuEEuw4jU) is more aimed at deep space operations and possible travel to mars. We expect to have a working prototype in 2022.

We see a bright future for further cooperation in space exploration with our Chinese brothers, now that [NASA is having more budget cuts](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/1010435) and cooperation with ESA has been troubling due to the [-Timothy Peake crisis-](https://voat.co/v/ModernPowers/comments/988830) involving the Brits not paying their bills. To further increase cooperation Roscosmos State Corporation has sent a team of expert engineers to Beijing to help with the development of The Chinese large modular space station, ["Tiangong Space Station"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinese_large_modular_space_station) . We think our expertise and experience will will be very valuable for the development of this project.

"We see this as the first steps in a beautiful friendship for the betterment of science and mankind in general" - Roscosmos main administrator [Igor Komarov](https://img.rt.com/files/2016.04/original/570ba503c4618870558b459f.jpg)

Meanwhile the Russian Space taxi company is helping western astronauts getting back and forth from the ISS as NASA, JAXA and the ESA still lack any alternatives for manned space flights. A good 328 million usd has been billed to NASA for transporting 4 capitalist astronauts to and from the ISS, 82 million USD to JAXA for transporting 1 japanese astronaut and 164 million USD to ESA for transporting two European astronauts (Not a Brit) over the last 2 years.
